decisions.reason: Cleaning soap builds directly on the firm's existing surface-treatment and wood-floor-care knowledge, allowing it to interpret customer feedback and improve the product.
Maintenance oil is closely related to the firm's established surface-treatment expertise and product-line format, giving it strong absorptive capacity to learn and improve.

Care product for oiled wood floors is highly related to existing wood-floor finishing know-how and has gained dedicated website attention, suggesting the firm can assimilate results and keep improving.
Moisture-protection underlayment is connected to the firm's technical knowledge of wood-floor installation and moisture management, so it can learn from early results and continue.
High-density foam underlay is the least related to the firm's wood-processing and surface-treatment capabilities, limiting its ability to interpret technical feedback and improve the product.
Oak parquet flooring is at the core of the firm's wood-processing knowledge and product-line strategy, so it has high absorptive capacity and should be kept.
